av4: Built a JavaScript web-scraping pipeline for automating manual data collection and surfacing market-trend signals for pricing decisions.
p_gg2: Developed per-gene protein-prediction models using OLS and GPU Random Forest ensemble for 11,459 genes with resumable chunked GPU training.
